wiki.title: Rhodesia Ransom
wiki.extract: Rhodesia Ransom is an American politician serving as a member of the California State Assembly for the 13th district, based in San Joaquin County, since 2024. A Democrat, she previously served on the Tracy City Council from 2016 to 2020.
